component.name: Ranslator
component.summary: Translate selected text and words on your screen

description.p: A native translator for Linux desktops. Translate text selections or capture a screenshot and select recognized words. Use local Ollama models, compatible LLM APIs, LibreTranslate, MyMemory, or a command-line runtime.
English OCR is bundled. Automatic mode prefers an installed Ollama model and otherwise uses the online MyMemory service.
